config.lambda_g_rule: number of windows × lambda_per_column; all choices reported
config.history_penalty: squared residual in training-row-standardized past outputs
config.output_initialization: two actual zero-input samples, past inputs exact, past outputs soft, current outputs exact
config.output_cost: position/angle as authored; velocities from forward normalized-time differences; terminal velocity from last difference
config.neighbor_code_audit: pe.hankel_matrix flattens multichannel data; dataset.py has different units/plant/collection, so neither reused
config.ensemble: Optional E5: five episode-bootstrap deterministic models, mean member cost, first-action feedback; PETS-lite, not full PETS
config.limitations: Mosaic trajectory span is exact only for adequately excited LTI data; regularization does not make it exact for nonlinear cart-pole. The relative SVD cutoff discards numerically small nonzero directions as well as exact null directions.

oracle_exploration_scaling: learned training scaling; plant replaced only
